articleTitle: Revisiting the “Problem” and Its Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Currently, we can see the significant variety of processed information and the unprecedented rate of increase in its volumes as well as the ambiguity of the assessment of situations, errors in the choice of priorities, and inconsistency of requirements. All of this contribute to the increasingly frequent emergence of situations with insufficiently identified or detected conditions and with an uncertain goal in various areas, namely, problems. Often problems are amorphous formations, without (or with partial) pre-assignment and formulation. It is urgent now to train future specialists, which will be able to identify problems, formulate them and overcome them within team working. Hence, the development of models and methods for identifying the structure of the problem is relevant either for education and training of future personnel or for researchers and developers of decision support systems regarding complex practical problems in social, economic, and production systems. The success of overcoming a problem depends on the quality of its formulation. The work discusses approaches to defining the concept of “problem” as well as its structure.

articleTitle: Using Industry 4.0 Tools in the Process of Training Metallurgical Engineers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this article, we will look at the use of industry 4.0 tools in the training of metallurgical engineers. We will discuss exactly which tools can be used and how they can improve the learning process. We will also consider the key advantages and disadvantages of using Industry 4.0 tools in the process of training metallurgical engineers.

articleTitle: The Possibilities of Using Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Education and Science
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article discusses the practical implementation of artificial intelligence (ai) in education and scientific research. It provides examples of how and why ai is necessary and draws conclusions about how people's lives may change after ai is integrated into society.

articleTitle: Applying of Predictive Neural Network Controllers in a Hydraulic Control Object
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the control of a hydraulic object using predictive and predictive neural network control blocks in the MATLAB software environment, as well as their comparison with the classical PI controller on a laboratory setup. Application and implementation of these regulators in the educational process.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Support in Choosing Online Teacher Assistants for Evaluating Assignments Based on Belbin's Behavioral Roles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Prior to each online course launch, teachers face choosing a group of students to become assistants. In view of the fact that one of the main functions of an online teacher assistant (OTA) is evaluating assignments completed by students in a course, it is necessary to consider the presence of his qualities: readiness to carefully and painstakingly check works for compliance with the requirements and prepare detailed feedback, needed for this. Such traits usually have people with a certain psychological type. A students' psychotype is frequently taken into account in education. Quite often Belbin's behavioral roles are applied. Despite this, in the existing research, when searching for a group of OTAs, the students' psychological type is not considered. Also, Belbin's behavioral roles, most appropriate to OTA's role, are not defined in the research. In the paper, a method of decision-making support in choosing OTAs for evaluating assignments based on Belbin's behavioral roles and its program realization are proposed. The method was tested on IT -specialized student survey data employing software, developed by author, and LMS. Belbin's behavioral roles required for OTAs are identified utilizing natural language processing.

articleTitle: Generative Language Models in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Large language models as part of artificial intelligence technologies have been rapidly developed in recent years. It become possible thanks to models based on neural networks and generative learning methods. GPT-based systems have become an integral part of many social and economic sectors. Education, including higher education, has also not been left out of the world of large language models. These models provide not only new opportunities, but also risks for the education system. This paper examines various aspects of the application of large language models for higher education. The results of a survey of learners and teachers on how they apply these new technologies in their activities are presented. One of the main problem of large language models usage is the high level of learners' usage of them and low level of teachers' usage of the technique. Another problem is irresponsible usage of artificial intelligence methods by students.

articleTitle: Creating Self-Updating Digital Platforms Using Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Continuous Education and Professional Development
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper proposes leveraging artificial intelligence to create self-updating digital education platforms that can continually refresh their content and provide adaptive personalized learning. Automated curation and contextualization of the latest knowledge using machine learning and natural language processing can make courseware dynamic and learner-needs based. Recommendations encompass public-private collaboration in developing national- level AI infrastructure and policies to make such next- generation systems mainstream. Self-evolving platforms promise to unlock democratized, flexible and lifelong learning critical for workforce resilience.

articleTitle: Development of Automated Control System for Laboratory Reactoplast Casting Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of an automated control system for the technological process of casting reactoplastic products in a laboratory environment. The primary objective is to design an integrated control system and a comprehensive software suite to manage process parameters, enabling the use of various grades of reactoplastics efficiently. The development process involved creating a detailed electrical schematic and an operational algorithm for the equipment. Essential components were meticulously selected to construct a laboratory prototype, leading to the establishment of a reliable automated control system. Additionally, a sophisticated software suite was developed and registered with Rospatent, ensuring intellectual property protection. Extensive experimental casting trials were conducted, resulting in high-quality plastic part samples that demonstrate the system's effectiveness. The proposed system showcases significant advancements in improving the quality and efficiency of small-batch production of plastic components, highlighting its potential for broader industrial applications.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Control Systems and Differential Inclusions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In discrete or continuous-time models of distributed control systems, each of the equations usually describes a change in the state of one of the constituent blocks (or nodes) of the modeled object or process. In real processes it is possible that at the next clock cycle not all blocks can be triggered simultaneously (synchronous case), but only one or several (asynchronous case). One of the classes of models that take into account possible asynchrony of processes are Petri nets. The transition from a synchronous model to an asynchronous one (“asynchronization”) can change the reachability domains for control system states. In the continuous case, asynchronization of a conventional dynamic system (without control) can be described as a transition to differential inclusion of a special type. In this article we study the influence of asynchronization on the reachability domains in the case of some simple linear dynamic systems on the plane. The topics discussed in the article will be useful in the educational process when studying courses in control theory and differential equations.

articleTitle: Verification of Genuineness of Educational Internet Resources Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The analysis of various sources has been carried out, confirming the demand for protective solutions against information threats from fake websites of organizations. The relevance of the research topic is confirmed by the presence of addresses similar in spelling to popular educational Internet resources in the list of domain names of the RU zone registered over the past year. When developing security solutions, it is proposed to use a site verifying the genuineness method based on the use of machine learning algorithms. A review of research by various authors has been conducted in order to determine the most frequently used features for verifying the genuineness of Internet resources in the machine learning models. The authors propose their own verifying the genuineness features that can be used in a situation where data about an Internet resource is extracted from the domain name registry. The proposed features differ from the known ones in that they contain signs of micro-markup on the site and storage of site settings files for search engines on servers. The developed features were tested using a naive Bayesian classifier as a machine learning algorithm. The proposed features can be used in the implementation of a software tool to counteraction threats from fake educational sites.

articleTitle: Practical Aspects of the Formation of Professional Ethics of Future Engineers in the Process of Studying the Fundamentals of Economics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Professional development of students is a process of development of self-awareness, including self-improvement of professionally important personality traits, self-education, as well as the formation of a value-motivational attitude towards a future profession. The latter presupposes not only receiving appropriate professional training, but also accepting the foundations of a humanistic worldview. One of the disciplines that contributes to the formation of the ethical competence of an engineer is the discipline “Fundamentals of Economics”. Studying a number of topics in this discipline can help develop in future engineers a sense of concern for the public welfare.

articleTitle: Near-periodic Analysis of Global Monthly Temperature Anomaly
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: It is known that one of the climatic factors influencing climate change and weather conditions is temperature. It influences both the well-being of people and global climatic processes occurring in the world. Tracking temperature changes is an important task that allows analyzing trends in temperature changes and predicting crisis temperature changes. This paper presents the results of analyzing global land and ocean temperature changes. Using near-periodic analysis, which allows to identify structural periodic dependencies of the studied data and to forecast crisis values, the main periodic components of the studied data were identified and forecast estimates were made on their basis. The applied method of data analysis is proposed to be used as part of the educational process in disciplines related to data analysis. Currently, the method is actively taught to students of RTU MIREA within the framework of Bachelor's and Master's degrees.

articleTitle: Some Innovations in the Linear Algebra Course
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article proposes a number of innovations in the linear algebra course. A simple and convenient rule for implementing Gaussian elimination when transforming a matrix is proposed. Further, in the construction of the course, matrices with vector elements are systematically used, when presenting the theory of bilinear functions, the bilinear function is treated as a binary operation on vectors (with the appropriate notation), the operation extends (like a multiplication) to matrices with vector elements, all this makes the formulations and proofs of the theorems concise and clear. The paper also offers a concise and elegant proof of the theorem that all eigenvalues of a symmetric matrix are real numbers.

articleTitle: Managing the Composition of Training Reflexive- active System of Artificial Heterogeneous Intelligent Agents
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper discusses an approach to constructing virtual reality training simulators based on reflexive-active systems of artificial heterogeneous intelligent agents. Thanks to the dynamic composition and structure of agent connections, virtual reality training simulators based on reflexive-active systems of artificial heterogeneous intelligent agents will be able to flexibly adapt to the user's capabilities, taking into account his abilities and progress in learning. Agents of such systems are characterized by the ability to reflexively model each other's behavior, including an interface agent that ensures user interaction with the system and represents the user's agent in the virtual system of agents. Thus, the most relevant use of such simulators is to train personnel in control mechanisms in environments where control objects show signs of subjectivity. This paper examines in detail the mechanisms for managing the composition of agents of the proposed systems.

Author Keywords: reflexive-active system of artificial heterogeneous intelligent agents

articleTitle: Theoretical Foundations for Organizing Research Work of Undergraduate Mathematicians
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article explores the theoretical foundations of organizing research work for students in master's programs in mathematics departments. The authors formulate the goals and objectives of students' research work, determine its structure, forms, stages, content and organization by semester.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Developing Financial Literacy of Future Digital Consultants in the Context of the Digitalisation of Society
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This study delves into the unique aspects of the formation of digital financial literacy among future digital consultants., particularly focusing on the modules of the training program and the structure of the module “Organization of work activities in advising citizens in the field of digital literacy”.

articleTitle: The Interactive Aspect of Students' Independent Work
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the interactive aspect of students' independent work, including, inter alia, students' designinganindividualeducationalroute,theuseofinteractive educational materials and teaching aids. Directions and methods are given, and the effectiveness of the interactive aspect of students' independent work, including work with literary sources, is shown. The project work is proposed andthe results of the students' work are presented.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Optimal Selection of a Strategy for Designing Corporate Information Systems Using Multi-criteria Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article presents the formation of an algorithm for optimal selection of a corporate information system (CIS) design strategy, taking into account numerous criteria and interests of various stakeholders. The algorithm is based on a comprehensive approach that combines the advantages of several multi-criteria analysis methods: the structured hierarchical approach of the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), the use of quantitative assessments and preference functions from the PROMETHEE method, as well as the concept of approximation to the ideal solution from the TOPSIS method. The proposed algorithm allows taking into account the interests of all decision makers (DMs) involved in the CIS project, and ensuring a balanced choice of design strategy considering heterogeneous criteria: functional, technical, financial, etc. The key advantages are flexibility, the ability to work with heterogeneous criteria and different types of data, as well as transparency and interpretability of results for DMs. To demonstrate the operation of the algorithm, the development of specialized software with modules for DM management, criteria, criteria weight assessment, analysis of alternative strategies, and report generation is underway.

articleTitle: Natural Intelligence vs. Artificial Intelligence: Understanding Emotions in Literary Texts
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to understanding the comparability of human beings and Artificial Intelligence (AI) models in extracting emotions from literary texts. The study employs some classical approaches to analyze emotions sentiment and suggests some ways to interpret the obtained results.

articleTitle: Informatics Leveling Training Methodical System Development for the First-year Students of a Technical University
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article presents a leveling training methodical system development of students' knowledge, skills and abilities to use the information technologies due to their different pre- university training, explains the authors' idea of leveling training methodical system development at example of teaching the first-year students to computer science. Suggested methodical system permits to determine the goals, content, forms, methods and means of training taken into account the profile of technical specialties such as “Construction”, “Operation of transport and transport-technological mechanisms and complexes” and “Software Engineering”. Features and specifics of educational material on computer science using information technologies are described due to the profile of different areas of technical specialists' training.

articleTitle: Research of Social Anxiety of University Students Using Web Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of a web application., which is a convenient platform for conducting psychological tests to determine the level of social anxiety in a student audience, processing results and analyzing data using cluster analysis methods. React.js was used for the client side of the development and for the server side - the Python programming language and the Django framework.

articleTitle: Digital Skills in Learners' Project Activities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Today, the technology of project-based learning is one of the leading educational technologies in the process of training personnel for the digital economy. This type of training has a valuable potential towards the formation of students' digital competencies. Practice-oriented learning, digital environment and interdisciplinary nature of research, small groups of learners allow for obtaining significant results in the training of future specialists capable of solving professional tasks of any complexity levels. The article presents several cases realized in the course of interdisciplinary project-research activities.

articleTitle: The Training Program for Solving Matrix Games
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The use of training programs in the educational process increases its effectiveness. One of the important types of such programs is programs for training in solving specific practical problems. The article discusses a training program for solving matrix games using the simplex method. The possibilities of programs for independent work of students and conducting control activities are presented. The results are presented showing the effectiveness of using the program to solve the task by students.

articleTitle: Law Students' Professional Competences Assessment Model in the Context of Digitalization of Education and Workplace
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: As digital transformation of the economy is in a full swing with labour markets duly responding, higher education needs a fundamentally new approach to educational process organisation. Building new learning environments means profound changes at all levels of functioning of educational institutions. One of the most urgent tasks is to adjust learning results assessment and evaluation schemes so that they are in line with the latest trends. The authors explore the reasons why the existing higher education outcomes assessment systems are not consistent with competence-based objectives set up by Federal State Educational Standards. The article summarises methodological principles of assessment tools funds development and proposes practical steps to develop a model of law students' performance assessment system incorporating professional and digital competences. The model covers three stages: defining the scope of professional functions and competences, producing the inventory of necessary digital skills to supplement professional tasks and developing assessment methods and materials.

articleTitle: Practice-Oriented Approach to Reforming the Traditional Model of Higher Education with the Application of EdTech Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for transforming conventional theoretical higher education models by integrating immersive EdTech tools and active pedagogies to impart creative, adaptive, and technologically proficient competencies vital for the 21st century. A qualitative analysis highlights the need for learner-driven, practice-focused, and technology-enabled learning over passive instruction to develop future-ready skills. Recommendations are provided for implementing EdTech innovations, work-integrated curricula, educator capacity building, and inclusive access. Ultimately, reforming higher education can catalyze a paradigm shift focused on nurturing lifelong learning mindsets and ethical progress.

articleTitle: Mechanisms and Conditions for Implementation of a Model of Digital Educational Environment of Preschool Educational Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the mechanisms and conditions for implementing the model of the digital educational environment of preschool educational organizations: organizational, material and technical, psychological and pedagogical, personnel. The requirements that the digital educational environment of preschool educational organizations must meet are reflected, and their theoretical justification is given.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article focuses on the use of artificial intelligence technologies in education. The capabilities of chatbot platforms have been studied, problems associated with their use in educational activities have been identified, and the specifics of using the capabilities of artificial intelligence have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Formation of the Intellectual Sphere of Students through Informatization of the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to analyze the effectiveness of informatization and digitalization of the educational environment of a higher institution. To achieve this goal, we have identified the following tasks: to analyze traditional teaching methods, to identify the opportunities that the electronic sphere provides to students. The study revealed that informatization and digitalization of the modern educational environment of a university is closely related to modernization pedagogical processes. We have concluded that the necessary basis for modernization processes is advanced technologies that are developing and transforming from information to digital. Methods: analysis, synthesis, theoretical modeling, statistical processing of materials, comparative assessment.

articleTitle: Establishing National Cloud Repositories for Scientific Data as a Solution for Reliable Long-Term Preservation of Research Outputs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for establishing national cloud-based repositories purpose-built for reliable long-term preservation and access to burgeoning research data. Robust networked infrastructure can overcome fragility risks facing data stored across fragmented institutional systems. Recommendations are provided encompassing architectural principles, sustainability models, curation standards, access policies and capacity building to guide development. Strategic public investment in shared research data infrastructure can secure invaluable knowledge assets and spark new discovery through data integration.

articleTitle: A Full Stack of Projector Revolution Innovations That Needed Only to Restore a Defolt Classboard Functionality at New Potentially Possible Data Transmission Capacity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this article we explain how to finalize the over-forced data injection revolution, produced by the usage of multimedia projectors (and a variety of other presentation devices) in education. The projector 'as is' is not a better class board., as it mutually doesn't reproduce its default functional and rather non-trivial special measures should be taken only to restore all its mutual functionalities - clear attention focus in step-by-step explanation generally synchronized with understanding and understanding supervising via following the teacher (lecture) by writing the conspectus and simultaneous or farther understanding checking in task solving with simultaneous or further (seminar) discussions. As it was shown by short lectures (like in Google format, lasting usually for several minutes) the increase of capacity in data transmission may be if not by one order, but at least several times. But this would not be the case with learning velocity increase if one does not produce proportional and simultaneous advance in a full stack of data receiving procedures including final control, intermediate assistance, and proper presentation format maintenance adequately synchronized with normal pupil operative memory size. Here we discuss measures that guarantee the corresponding result. If other tactics will appear it may be a topic of new discussion to run.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Developing Computational Thinking When Teaching Students in the Field of Study Applied Mathematics and Computer Science
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The goal of modern educational systems is to prepare not just a performer, but a creatively developed personality capable of solving non-standard problems in the changing conditions of professional activity. A higher educational institution requires the introduction of new approaches to teaching that ensure the development of professional, creative, information, and communicative competencies of graduates. The article presents the discipline “Numerical Methods” and “Theory of Computational Experiments”, which are basic for students in the field of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science. The knowledge, skills and abilities obtained while studying the discipline will make it possible to carry out applied projects in the field of mathematics, natural sciences, operations research, and machine learning. These disciplines can also be recommended to students in the areas of training Applied Informatics and Mathematical Support of Information Systems due to the importance of mastering this material and subsequent use in solving applied problems.

articleTitle: Establishing Specialized Research and Education Centers as an Imperative for Training Next-Generation IT Specialists
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for establishing dedicated interdisciplinary research and education centers focused on advanced IT skills development through integrative cyber-science programs, industry partnerships, and experiential learning. These specialized centers can address the severe talent deficit facing technology firms and revamp conventional siloed technical education. Recommendations are provided for coordinated national action to develop such centers as hubs cultivating sophisticated digital competencies via immersive projects, global networks, and convergence thinking. They can catalyze purpose-driven, inclusive technology innovation and progress.

articleTitle: Implementation of Contextual Training for Mechanical Engineering Students in the Field of Maintenance of Technological Equipment Based on Electronic Educational Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: To train bachelors of mechanics in the field of equipment maintenance, a modular principle of developing competencies based on contextual learning is proposed. Information and educational technology has been developed. Examples of technology implementation using electronic educational resources and a developed computer program for assessing reliability indicators are considered.

articleTitle: Possibilities of Applying Educational Robotics Instudents' Project Activities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Robotics, representing a synthesis of scientific knowledge, engineering creativity, and programming, is becoming increasingly demanded in educational practice. The author analyzes the results of their own research, based on experience in integrating educational robots into the curriculum for students majoring in pedagogy. These studies confirm that the use of robotics stimulates active student participation in the learning process, enhances their motivation, and improves the assimilation of educational material. The scientific significance of the research lies in its ability to enrich pedagogical theory and stimulate further research in the field of educational robotics

articleTitle: Goals-Setting as a Requirement Interiorization of Research Culture of Future Engineers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The goal is to determine the importance of goalsetting and independence in setting priorities for research activities among engineering students in the formation of a research culture. Based on the results of the study, it was concluded that a student's accumulation of experience and knowledge about research activities without a conscious understanding of its personal value, significance and self- identification as a subject of research and goal-setting, even in conjunction with the development of professional competencies, does not ensure the formation of a high-level research culture.

articleTitle: Educational and Professional Potential of Advanced Training Courses in the Field of Road Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In connection with new requirements for certain types of professional activities in the field of road construction, the problem of personnel retraining is becoming increasingly urgent. Thanks to additional professional education, specialists can quickly change their qualifications with account of the trends that have formed at the moment in the labor market. The construction and road industries are currently experiencing a real shortage of personnel. The study proposes a solution to the problem through intensive training of specialists in advanced training and retraining courses. The work reveals the concepts of creating author's courses in the field of road construction. The educational and professional potential of the Lipetsk State Technical University additional professional education system for the training and retraining of employees of the Lipetskdoravtocentre has been revealed. The importance of this area is confirmed by the “System-wide measures for the development of road infrastructure” project as part of the “Safe Quality Roads” national project which regulates the training of personnel in the system of additional professional education.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies in Technical Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Usually technical disciplines such as mathematical analysis, algebra, analytical geometry, electrical engineering and others cause students difficulties in studying and do not arouse interest. Modern digital technologies can improve the performance and motivate students. The paper considers the use of new teaching methods, modern digital technologies, the use of student preferences. It is shown that these techniques contribute to improving the quality of the educational process and develop students' digital literacy.

articleTitle: The Role of Online Processes in the Re-Evaluation of Educational Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The task of the work is to study the effectiveness of the use of new technologies in education and to re-evaluate traditional methods and approaches in the educational process. The tasks are to analyze the fundamental methods, including visibility and the requirement of structuring, to evaluate a new pedagogical technology - intelligence maps as an approach to structuring information in visual form in order to stimulate mental activity and creativity. The conducted research allows us to conclude that it is necessary to use special technologies in the organization of online education, which allows students to choose an individual trajectory for mastering educational programs. Methods: analysis, synthesis, theoretical modeling, statistical processing of materials, comparative evaluation.

articleTitle: Interactive Learning to Solve the Problem of Thermostatics Using the Energy Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: An interactive approach to providing the educational process is demonstrated by applying the method of boundary states to solving the Dirichlet problem for the homogeneous Laplace equation describing the thermostatic state of the body. Cylinders without a cavity and with a spherical cavity are considered as examples. Calculations have been performed, the results have been commented on, and conclusions have been written.

articleTitle: Methodology for Determining the Relationship Between Manifestation Degree of Certain Abilities and Perception Degree of the Psychological Settings' Influence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In modern society, there's an accelerated change in personal preferences among young people, which complicates the process of development of both individual potential and society as a whole. This article draws attention to the need of taking into account the capabilities and abilities of an individual when analyzing his activities. It is noted that the successful implementation of activities depends not only on motivation, but also on compliance with a person's abilities. The authors of the article draw attention to the importance of analyzing the individual's relationship to the world around him through activity, as well as the significance of the result of this activity for a person's self-identification. The article discusses the theory of activity approach, which was developed by Leontyev A.N., Rubinshtein S.L., Vygotsky L.S., Khutorsky A.V. and others. The authors emphasize the importance of this theory for understanding the internal mechanisms of human activity and its connection with the self-awareness of the individual in society. The article analyzes modern research in this area and points out the disadvantages of not taking into account the abilities of an individual when analyzing his activities. Thus, the article offers a new look at the process of carrying out activities through the prism of individual abilities and emphasizes the need to integrate this aspect into modern research in the field of psychology and pedagogics.

articleTitle: Efficiency of Modular Study of IT and Mathematical Disciplines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this paper the teaching of IT and mathematical courses for the international bachelor program in English is discussed. A combination of automated and traditional control procedures are used. The results of midterm and final examinations are analyzed. Correlation and clustering results are presented.

articleTitle: An Overview of the Problems and Features of Modeling Modern Rating Systems in International Research
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article provides an overview of international-level research on the study, modeling and structural modernization of rating systems. The main topical problems that independent researchers have repeatedly encountered, as well as examples of popular vulnerabilities of existing systems, are highlighted. The proposed ways of solving the identified problems, the unique features of approaches to the study of this topic, as well as non-standard structural solutions in the development of models are studied. The important features of the development of rating structures from different fields are considered, the nuances of working with social rating are noted, the relevance of using a multidisciplinary approach is highlighted. Approaches to the selection of key parameters in the development of complex models are investigated, and the need to use complex multicriteria models in the structure of rating systems is confirmed by examples. The prospects of using Petri nets in modeling a rating system are considered. The promising direction of further development of rating systems has been revealed.

articleTitle: Enhancing IT Education Through Docker Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Adapting educational approaches to modern tech-nologies is imperative for universities and educational institutions. This article dives into the integration of Docker into educational curricula to enrich the learning experience for students in IT education and related fields. Compared to traditional vir-tual machines., Docker offers lightweight and swift deployment., simplifying the encapsulation of applications and their depend-encies into containers. By incorporating Docker into the curriculum., students gain practical insights into application development., deployment., and management within simulated real-world environments. The article presents case studies highlighting Docker's implementation in educational settings., including its use in stand-ardizing programming environments., reducing students' anxi-ety levels., and enhancing cybersecurity education. These studies showcase Docker's efficiency in streamlining the setup process., ensuring consistency., and fostering collaboration among stu-dents. Furthermore., the research findings underscore Docker's versatility in facilitating diverse learning methodologies and its potential to revolutionize educational practices. While Docker integration presents various benefits., the arti-cle acknowledges potential limitations., such as security risks as-sociated with public repositories and challenges pertaining to the lack of graphical user interfaces (GUI) and resource man-agement. Despite these limitations., Docker emerges as a trans-formative tool for modernizing educational curricula and pre-paring students for the dynamic landscape of IT.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence System to Determine Student's Optimal Individual Educational Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the results of the case study on applying AI approaches to create mathematical basis for the recommendation service which can be used to find student's optimal individual educational trajectory. Classical Neural Network model was used for the modeling of the aggregated student's rate after graduation the university; results of unified state examination were taken as inputs of the model. The numerical example is presented for selected majors connected with IT and Mathematics; the obtained result (calculated MAE) is 0.092% which indicates high accuracy of the proposed neural network. There are also presented the analysis of scenarios of the service development and SWOT-analysis of possible model application. There are given recommendations how to improve the model by adding different information characterizing students' satisfaction by the educational process.

articleTitle: Technologies for the Formation of National Identity When Teaching Students a Foreign Language
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: National identity is one of the key aspects of the culture and self-awareness of the people and is of great importance for strengthening social stability, preserving cultural heritage, language and developing national self-awareness. National identity can influence political and social processes in society can help strengthen national unity, and stimulate citizen participation in society and politics. Teaching foreign languages is considered not just as a means of communication and a way to gain knowledge, but also as an opportunity to understand the national and cultural characteristics of the people who speak it. Modern society needs competent, creative and active specialists, whose training will not be relevant and sufficient without acquiring knowledge not only about the culture of the countries of the language being studied, but also about their own culture. That is why a foreign language has priority importance as a means of intercultural communication and generalization of the spiritual heritage of the countries and peoples of the studied and native languages. The process of language acquisition should be accompanied by the study of a foreign language culture, since this allows students to expand their picture of the world, forming a respectful attitude towards the values of another nation. With this approach to the process of teaching a foreign language, native culture is compared with the culture of the people whose language is being studied, students' knowledge of their native culture is deepened, and national self-awareness is cultivated.

articleTitle: The Use of Gamification Technology in Student Team Projects in IT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the use of gamification technology in student team projects. At the theoretical level, the competence model of a future IT specialist is considered; the necessity of creating psychological, educational and organizational conditions for increasing the level of motivation and involvement of students in teamwork is substantiated; the current state of pedagogical research in the field of gamification of the educational process is analyzed. An algorithm of gamification technology implementation is proposed. The learning potential of the educational gamification platform Classcraft is demonstrated by the example of a student team project in IT.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning for Automatic Pronunciation Assessment in a Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper explores the application of the QuartzNet neural network model for pronunciation assessment. We employed the model from the Nvidia NeMo toolkit and fine-tuned it on the LibriSpecch with additional speaker from LJSpeech. To ensure accurate mapping between sounds and linguistic units, we replaced grapheme-based transcriptions with phoneme-based ones. Evaluation on the Speechocean762 dataset revealed a notably high correlation with expert assessments. The paper delves into the specifics and intricacies of the model training and testing process and the stages involved in developing the Android mobile application. The application leverages the pre-trained QuartzNet model and assesses user pronunciation based on the Character Error Rate (CER) between the hypothesis and the reference transcription. QuartzNet's lightweight nature and efficient inference capabilities enabled on-device inference directly on the user's device (Android smartphone). Testing results and comparisons with other pronunciation assessment tools demonstrate the effectiveness and potential of the application for aiding pronunciation improvement and English lanauage learning.

articleTitle: Reforming the Research Grants System to Support Cyber-Science and Empower the Scientific Community
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for reforming the national research grants system by adopting international best practices to support pioneering domains like cyber-science. Dedicated funding channels, streamlined requirements, grant managers and productivity metrics can transform outdated norms that constrain exploratory science. Recommendations are provided to recalibrate policies and institute supporting roles for empowering researchers. An optimized grants infrastructure can massively strengthen the cyber-science ecosystem to drive socially responsible innovation.

articleTitle: The Role of Open Educational Resources in Advancing Distance and Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper highlights the vital role of open educational resources (OERs) in advancing distance and online learning worldwide through affordable, accessible and quality content. Recommendations encompass developing collaborative OER frameworks, federated digital infrastructure and capability building to drive adoption. OER integration can achieve over 50% cost savings for learners compared to traditional content. With concerted efforts, OERs can profoundly transform online education as enablers of inclusion, lifelong learning and knowledge equity.

articleTitle: The Use of Virtual Interactive Stands in the Educational Process in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Information and communication technologies have become an integral part of modern society in Uzbekistan, as they are used in all spheres of human life: economic, political and social. Uzbekistan is one of the countries where digital technologies are rapidly developing, because of which significant results have been achieved in education. The expansion of distance education will improve the quality of education, because more students who live in rural areas are covered. This will allow you to receive high-quality content (video, audio, and platform); use the most up-to-date technologies and solutions: online services for the educational process, gamification, a virtual library, online proctoring and practical online classes. Interactive learning is a learning process using information and communication technologies. Although distance learning is not a substitute for university attendance, it is an excellent learning tool for consolidating knowledge and obtaining additional facts and information. Sometimes homework is not enough for proper understanding and assimilation of educational material. Proper understanding of information is useful for practical subjects. The Internet provides a wide range of such additional features. Interactive stands enhance both general and professional knowledge; have a motivating effect on learning in a playful way. The National Research University in Uzbekistan, together with the teachers of the Tashkent State Pedagogical University, is actively working on the introduction of virtual interactive educational stands into the educational process, including distance education. The computer program provides for the implementation of training lessons in the section “Logical foundations of computing systems”, namely “Representation of functions of the algebra of logic”, “Minimization of logical functions by the Veitch diagram method”, “Minimization of logical functions by the Quine method”

articleTitle: Modernizing Educational Programs by Integrating AI and Advanced Technologies Topics to Enhance Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for the imperative of modernizing educational programs by integrating dedicated modules on artificial intelligence, machine learning, intelligent systems, extended reality, data science and other advanced technology topics. This can address the skills gap faced by graduates and enhance the competitiveness, relevance and future-readiness of higher education. Recommendations are provided for updating standards, faculty development, industry linkages and accreditation frameworks to enable nation-wide adoption. Curriculum modernization can activate lifelong learning mindsets vital for the 21st century.

articleTitle: Constructive and Destructive Effects of Mediatization of Historical Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The study analyzes the process of transformation of historical memory under the influence of digitalization. To reveal the specifics of the phenomenon of historical memory in the digital society, the concept of midi-memory is used to describe the mechanisms of storage and translation of collective representations of the past in the conditions of digitalization. The process of digitalization gradually erases the boundary between cultural and communicative memory. In addition, the number of subjects involved in the construction of representations of the past is significantly increasing. As a result, the mechanism of constructing images of the past is changing. These processes lead to the need to analyze the destructive and constructive effects of the mediatization of collective memory.

articleTitle: Digital Teaching Assistants: Application Experience and Assessment of the Level of Service at Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The topic of using digital assistants in education is becoming more relevant and significant in modern society. Teachers are faced with constantly changing requirements and expectations of students, as well as the need to effectively organize the learning process. In this regard, digital assistants are emerging as an innovative solution to cope with the challenges of modern education. The purpose of this study is to analyze the methods of using digital teaching assistants based on the experience of various universities and to develop an approach to assessing the level of service of digital assistants at the university.

articleTitle: Academic Entrepreneurship as an EdTech
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: University start-ups, organized in many countries, can be viewed as part of the academic curriculum because they are accompanied by the courses where the entrepreneurial experiences can be discussed in class with the instructor or become parts of the diploma projects. The entrepreneurial attitudes of the youth in Russia are supposed to be supported by the university management nowadays, since the federal higher education authorities require universities to stimulate academic entrepreneurship as a new educational technology. The main spheres in which university start-ups work successfully are business, economics, science and technologies. The paper aims at sharing the experience of start-up building both in commercially common and non-common fields, like arts and design, humanities, and education. The data presented in the paper encourage the introduction of the start-up approach as a compulsory one in professional education for students of any academic specialization.

articleTitle: Adaptive Traffic Control Through a Neuro- fuzzy Classifier for Predicting Traffic Network Tension Levels
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Even relatively small changes in traffic intensity or the capacity of busy sections of the road network can provide a sufficiently large reduction in traffic delays. Therefore, it is necessary to predict the location of the stressed points of the transport network in a timely manner, and apply one of the developed algorithms for redistributing traffic flows. Intersections and road sections in front of traffic lights are considered as possible stress points. The condition of each point in the transport network can be described using an input vector: information on the average speed of vehicles, traffic intensity and density, percentage of heavy vehicles, availability of repair zones, etc. There is also information about 6 fuzzy classes characterizing the degree of tension of the point (“free movement”, “stable movement”, “constant limited movement”, “constant movement with high density”, “saturated movement”, “congestion”). Each point can be assigned to a certain class with some degree of belonging [0, 1]. An algorithm for a neuro-fuzzy classifier using a fuzzy inference mechanism in solving the classification problem by a neural network with clear/fuzzy connections will be proposed.

articleTitle: Constructing of Multyparametrical Abcd - Learning Tasks for A Variety of Applied Mathematics Disciplines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Here we develop a number of techniques for multiparametric task creation. This problem arises if we build algorithmically close tasks of nearly equal hardness for probably simultaneous solving in the classroom with nearly the only difference in individual parameters. The set of parameters should be thick enough to avoid multiple collisions in the student flow of up to 100 people. And this requires no less than 10,000 variants. A curious aspect is that after such an abcd-task had been properly created one often has no need and sometimes has no obvious possibility to create principally different tasks of the same difficulty on the same topic. This circumstance along with multiple other conveniences of abcd-task makes it a connerstone of the learning process.

articleTitle: AI Technologies in Training PhD Students
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the following decades AI-based techniques are likely to be the driving force for transforming every segment of human society, education included. AI technologies obviously undergo a period of intense growth of reputation and expectations at all levels of professional education and have true potential for enhancing postgraduate qualification programs as well. This paper explores the perspectives of implementing Speech-to- Text (STT) & Text-to-Speech (TTS) tools in redesigning PhD studies curriculum as speech recognition and text-to-speech instruments are supposed to be effectively used both for academic purposes and in research. Even now the individual needs of PhD students in scientific data processing can be covered with existing automatic speech/text recognition free access apps through their multifold settings. But as our survey shows, only few postgraduate students are familiar with the STT and TTS tools, which makes it vital to incorporate these techniques into postgraduate education for it to become more versatile.

articleTitle: Symmetric Substitution Groups of Problem-Oriented Control Systems and Trusted Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Information on problem-oriented control systems and trusted artificial intelligence is provided. It is noted that one of the directions for the development and description of machine learning methods and models of artificial intelligence systems is the axiomatic foundations of substitution functions in the number system of a factorial sets series.

articleTitle: Multiple Criteria Choice of Assignment Assessment System in Online Courses in Learning Management Employing ELECTRE Method Variations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The main control elements in online courses are tests and assignments. The latter are utilized for checking the quality of performance of works with free response, e.g. practicals. Numerous research studies, dedicated to online learning, address various issues of assignments. However, a matter related to selecting the most appropriate assessment system used in assignments, is insufficiently developed. For instance, in the existing research, a task of a multiple criteria choice of assignment assessment system is not set, and interests of all basic roles, involved in online courses, are not taken into account. To overcome the problem, a technique of the multiple criteria choice of assignment assessment system, employing ELECTRE method variations and considering interests of the roles: a teacher-online course developer, administrator-moderator, teacher assistant/peer reviewer, checking an assignment, and learner, performing the assignment; is proposed in the paper. The technique was piloted involving the ELECTRE method variations: I, Iv, Is, II, III, IV and Python application, and allowed to find the most appropriate assignment assessment system.

articleTitle: Use of Neural Network Technologies in the Educational Activities of Primary School Teachers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article introduces the study of the effectiveness of the use of artificial intelligence and neural networks within the framework of primary general education. It is based on an analysis of technologies, the most effective tools for the use of information resources by teachers in the classroom. There are recommendations for teachers who work with a neural network.

articleTitle: The Experience of Training the Future Teachers to the Implementation of E-learning at School in the Context of Teaching Practice
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the approaches to the definition of online education. Its basic components are described. There is considered the experience of the training of the students in the pedagogical universities to the implementation of e-learning at school in the context of the production (pedagogical) practice.

articleTitle: Structure of the Formation Model of a Digital Educational Environment of a Preschool Educational Organization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article reveals one of the aspects of the problem of developing a model for the formation of a digital educational environment for a preschool educational organization, caused by the contradiction between the need for digitalization of preschool education and the spontaneous nature of this process due to the undevelopedness of its theoretical and methodological foundations. The conducted research is based on the analysis, synthesis, generalization of philosophical, cultural, sociological, psychological and pedagogical literature, as well as publications reflecting the experience of forming a digital educational environment of a preschool educational organization, which made it possible to develop a theoretical and methodological justification for the model of the formation of a digital educational environment of a preschool educational organization and determine its structure and content.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Assessment Methods in Digital Educational Technologies: Modeling and Statistical Analysis of Student Work Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article introduces a new adaptive assessment system in the educational sector, compared with traditional methods to demonstrate its superiority. Through statistical analysis of data over several years, it is proven that the implementation of this system enhances students' interest in learning. The focus is not on technological aspects but on pedagogical innovations and their impact on the educational process. The article emphasizes the need to develop new pedagogical techniques and assessment systems adapted to the digital era, highlighting the challenges and prospects for future education.

articleTitle: Countering the Negative Impact of Internet Technologies in Higher Education on the Example of Child Trafficking: Legal Dimension
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the context of digitalization, the problem of the negative impact of Internet technologies in higher education is becoming more acute. Technologies of influence on the Internet can have certain negative consequences for students, both for applicants and students. It is at the junction of childhood and adulthood (16–18 years old) that students are most vulnerable and suggestible, which is why they are drawn into criminal organizations for the purpose of human trafficking. Not only students, but also teachers who can take advanced training courses for teachers in both the humanities and technical disciplines should be proficient in technologies to counter negative influences in the Internet environment. The study examines the legal dimension of this problem, reveals the levels of counteraction, and describes strategies to counter the negative impact of Internet technologies.

articleTitle: Developing a Program for Digital and Intellectual Education of Youth as a Strategic Imperative for Training Innovation Leaders
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for developing ambitious nationwide programs for digital and intellectual education of youth, leveraging immersive technologies to build leadership, cultural intelligence, creativity, ethics and digital fluency vital for steering inclusive technological progress. Recommendations encompass public-private partnerships, experiential pedagogies, educator training and impact tracking for scaled implementation. Holistic digital and intellectual youth development can nurture empowered generations guiding sustainable innovation and development.

articleTitle: Role of Student Engineering Competitions in the Formation of Professional Competencies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article shows the role of engineering competitions in the disciplines of the main educational programs of higher educational institutions in the formation of professional competencies of students. A methodological and pedagogical system for organizing student competitions in mathematics, physics and computer graphics is presented using the example of the Volzhsky Polytechnical Institute (branch) of the Volgograd State Technical University (VPI (branch) VolgSTU). It is shown that engineering competitions are held with the aim of identifying talented youth, stimulating research activities of students, and improving the quality of professional training of graduates of higher educational institutions. It is substantiated that competitions are an important part of the educational process for developing students' skills in solving nonstandard problems based on the knowledge and skills acquired in lectures and practical classes. In the process of holding competitions in one discipline, knowledge from other disciplines is used, aimed at preparing students for their future profession. During the research, criteria were formed showing the degree to which students have mastered professional competencies. The article shows that for students, participation in competitions is not only a way to test their knowledge, but also to develop professional skills in practical activities. Also considered are such issues of motivating competition participants as obtaining additional points for the academic rating, publishing competition results on the website and social networks of the institute, and including competition results in the graduate's portfolio.

articleTitle: Practices of Consuming Educational Content in the Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to clarifying the practices of consuming educational content in a digital society. The article identifies the types and features of educational content. It has been established that digital educational content opens up new opportunities in knowledge and creates the prerequisites for a variety of forms of inclusion of students in the educational process. Models of consumer practices and their implementation features in the field of education are considered.

Author Keywords: transformation of the institution of education

articleTitle: Advancing E-Learning and M-Learning Environments Incorporating AI and Gamification to Boost Learner Motivation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper argues for advancing e-learning and m-learning platforms by integrating immersive technologies like AI, predictive analytics, gamification and extended reality. Incorporating personalization, microlearning, incentives and real-world scenarios can address engagement gaps with conventional self-paced platforms. Recommendations are provided for national implementation encompassing policy directives, funding support, capability frameworks, educator training and public-private partnerships. Optimized digital learning ecosystems can enable sticky, motivated and experiential learning essential for the digital era.

articleTitle: Developing and Applying a Neural Network System for Text Plagiarism Detection in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article focuses on the development and features of applying a neural network system for text plagiarism detection in higher education. In the context of the rapid growth in the availability of open information resources, the problem of academic honesty is becoming increasingly important. This article presents an approach that uses machine learning techniques, specifically a fully-connected neural network, to automatically detect plagiarism in academic and research works. The main stages of dataset creation, model development, and training are discussed, and the results of applying the model in practice are analyzed. Based on the test results, the average absolute error for the architecture with two hidden layers was found to be 9.38. The results of the study demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system in identifying plagiarism, making it a valuable tool to promote academic integrity and ensure educational quality.

articleTitle: Methodology of Applying Artificial Intelligence in Modern Architectural Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Currently., the use of artificial intelligence (AI) is gaining relevance in various branches of science and technology., in art. This article is devoted to the use of AI and neural networks in architectural education. An analysis of existing research has shown that science lacks a methodology for introducing artificial intelligence into the process of professional training of architects. As a result of familiarization with the trends in solving this problem in universities of other specialties., as well as taking into account the experience of pedagogical science., a conceptual model of the methodology for using AI and neural networks in architectural universities was formulated. The implementation of AI in vocational training is proposed to be solved at three levels - theoretical., communicative and practical. The use of artificial intelligence can be considered as an integral pedagogical process consisting of the following components: value-oriented, content-based., and performance-based. In the context of the issue under study., it is recommended that architecture students develop two areas of competence: creative thinking and the ability to use artificial intelligence in practical activities. The article also offers a forecast for the further development of artificial intelligence capabilities in education. The results of the work can serve as a basis on which other researchers can rely for further development of this topic.

articleTitle: Demonstration Exam as a Tool to Assess Professional Competencies Level of IT- Specialists
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to assess the level of competencies mastery in the field of information technology when studying specialized courses. This approach, which is also called the demonstration exam, consists of complex interaction between educational organizations and employer partners in the development of examination tasks, assessment criteria and conducting procedures. The interaction of educational organizations with partner employers makes it possible to guarantee that students, if they successfully pass the demonstration exam, acquire relevant and in-demand professional competencies in the labor market in the field of information technology.

articleTitle: An Experience of Abcd-Problems Based Brief Cryptography Introduction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Cryptography due to corresponding non-visual counter-intuitive mathematics is not a very suitable theme for basic general introductory applied mathematics courses for non-specialists. Still, according to the author's own experience of many thousand students teaching, there is a possible oversimplification of several basic first-generation asymmetric cryptography algorithms to (computerless) manual calculations level, that can be given in the middle of such an introductory course, providing a general understanding of fundamental technic, that may be an earliest career orientation step for some pupils (students) and an important brick of general education for all others.

articleTitle: Integration of Higher Education and the Manufacturing Sector Within the Framework of the Sharing Economy and Platform Employment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article defines and analyzes the factors that determined the rapid development of sharing in modern society and its widespread distribution, including in the field of interaction between enterprises and higher education. The influence of the integration of education and the real sector of the economy within the framework of platform employment is considered. Based on this, a possible option for organizing the practical work of students in the conditions of interaction between higher education and enterprises based on the principles of the sharing economy is proposed.

articleTitle: The Use of Clustering Methods in Machine Learning Systems Based on Metallurgical Production Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper considers the application of cluster analysis methods in machine learning systems of metallurgical production.

articleTitle: An Interdisciplinary Approach to the Training of Construction Specialists Within the Framework of the Profile “Organization and Management of Investment and Construction Activities”
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article shows that the investment and construction complex of Russia is in dire need of specialists in the field of construction who must independently solve engineering and technical problems of any complexity. Effective training of highly qualified personnel is possible when developing educational programs based on the interdisciplinary and competency-based approach. An example is the unique bachelor's program “Organization of investment and construction activities” developed to train a manager (customer, developer) of an investment project in the construction sector. The educational program was developed by the Department of Construction Materials and Road Technologies of Lipetsk State Technical University with the active participation of leading construction enterprises and organizations in the construction industry of the Lipetsk region, the Russian Federation, and the Republic of Iraq. Its specificity and uniqueness lie in the possibility of training highly qualified specialists in the field of construction, development, project management and finance, who have competence in Building Information Model for buildings and structures at all stages of the life cycle. This approach is in demand in the labor market both for construction enterprises that organize and carry out investment and construction activities, and for companies financing construction projects Building Information Model (BIM) perform several functions. The use of these technologies makes it possible to reduce the implementation time of an investment and construction project, significantly reduce its cost and improve quality.

articleTitle: The Socio-legal Aspect of the Profile of “Forest Cadets” as a Strategy of International Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The current school education system does not take into account modern trends in the development of the forestry industry. The article examines the socio-legal aspect of the profile of “Forest Cadets” and the dissemination of the practice of introducing a smart model of the professional educational trajectory of the target stream of school-university-employer in the MAEI “Secondary School No. 12 named after the Hero of the Russian Federation V.A. Dorokhin”. Attention is drawn to the commonality of the socio-Iegal framework of the Russian Federation and the Republic of Belarus concerning the education of future forestry specialists. The proposed aspects of international cooperation in the modular trajectory of interaction through effective learning activities, innovations, methodologies and practices are outlined.

articleTitle: Using Neural Networks in Building an Ontology of Educational Subjects for Solving Educational Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the modern world, information technologies have become an integral part of a human life, including the professional level. The rapid development of technologies based on artificial intelligence over the past few years has opened up new opportunities for their application in solving various educational tasks. One of the relevant topics for study is the investigation of ontological constructs in texts, identifying the terminology of concepts and determining the relationships between them. This article is dedicated to studying artificial intelligence systems as a tool for solving educational process tasks: it proposes the use of chatbots based on AI systems in conjunction with various digital tools in researching ontological constructs in educational texts. As part of the research, an example is provided with the processing an educational text on mathematics.
