Methodological characteristics are considered and a model for researching educational text using the ChatGPT is briefly described. Conclusions are drawn about the existing possibilities and difficulties in implementing the aforementioned model.

articleTitle: On the Implementation of Residual Knowledge Continuous Assessment Technology in an Educational Organization Using Artificial Intelligence Tools
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into the educational process represents a paradigm shift towards an adaptive and responsive higher education system. This paper examines an example of using AI to analyze the results of the technology for continuous assessment of residual knowledge (CARK), in the case of streaming disciplines. The problem of the complexity of technical implementation at the stage of assessing student responses in free form for residual knowledge assessment is formulated. The issue of computational power when training AI models for the tasks mentioned in the paper is considered.

Author Keywords: continuous assessment of residual knowledge technology

articleTitle: The Possibilities of Virtual Laboratory Work in Physics in the Educational Process at a Technical University
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the potential of virtual laboratory work as a tool in the educational process at a technical university. This approach can help students better understand large and complex physics concepts, bridge gaps in their school education, and develop practical skills in working with the material. Virtual models of real-life physical installations can be used to simulate laboratory work in various sections of general physics, including for students with special needs. Virtual laboratory work can be used as a temporary replacement for non-working physical installations during practical classes in a general physics course. In the distance learning context, this is the only viable way to organize a laboratory workshop. A virtual experiment allows you to visually represent complex processes and physical phenomena. The choice of virtual models should be based on the level of training of the students.

articleTitle: Language in Iconographic Images in the Process of Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the interactive aspect of studying icon painting. Online study provides a unique opportunity to combine tradition with modernity, opening up the great art of icon painting for everyone. Icon painting through online learning provides a unique opportunity to learn the techniques, materials and tools of this ancient art.

articleTitle: Technologies for Introducing Lean Methodology into the Work of University Career Centers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The concept of lean production has its own methods and tools, following which you can radically change the work of career centers and increase their efficiency several times. Today, the competitiveness of a university graduate is determined by his/her professional competencies. The article discusses technologies for introducing lean methodology into the work of career centers of universities to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of the work of these centers.

articleTitle: Distant Medical Education in a Foreign Language Medium of Instruction – Teachers' View of the Past, Present and Future
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The use of distant educational technologies in the teaching of future doctors at medical universities causes a lot of controversy, online education in a non-native language for students is also an issue of discussions. The article presents a study of such a complicated aspect of modern education as teaching foreign medical students through a non-native language using distance education technologies, including the results of a survey of teachers on this aspect, including differences in the results of a survey among teachers of humanitarian, natural sciences, biomedical and clinical disciplines of a medical university.

articleTitle: Study of Some Features of Organizing Work with Distance Learning Students
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Any higher education institution is interested in attracting and retaining students. The reasons for choosing a particular university, further education and diploma defense directly depend on the quality of the educational process and satisfaction of the needs of applicants and students. The article analyzed the results of the survey “The quality of the educational process at Lipetsk State Technical University” and put forward proposals for improving the quality of the educational environment, including with the help of information technology.

Author Keywords: improvement of conditions for receiving education

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Filters and Wavelet Transformations on Object Detection Quality on the Example of Vehicles Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of the impact of various image preprocessing methods on the results of object detection in images, with the purpose to identify the most effective techniques for eliminating visual anomalies in images before using them for training and deploying artificial neural networks in the field of computer vision. There was discovered some features of image preprocessing on the example of vehicles photographs captured by street surveillance cameras in the city of Lipetsk.

articleTitle: Sports Programming as a Tool for Regional Development of the Digital Industry and Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Abstract-The article presents the history of the development of sports programming as a sport in Russia. The main stages of the formation of the legislative basis for this sport are given. The rationale and description of the process of training athletes in higher education institutions are given - possible traj ectories in the disciplines of “algorithmic programming” and “product programming”, the influence of the development of sports programming on improving the quality of IT education. As an example, the organization of training students in the discipline of “algorithmic programming” at the Lipetsk State Technical University is given. The activities of the Lipetsk regional branch of the All- Russian Sports Federation to popularize this sport including among students are also described.

articleTitle: Adaptive Computer Testing as a Means of Improving the Quality of Education for Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: A model for the implementation of adaptability based on the use of the capabilities of a computing system is proposed with the aim of a more complete implementation of an individual approach in computer learning. The features of the presentation of educational content and the structuring of test materials are considered. The level of concretization of the survey, which is usually built in a modular form, differs in the depth of the survey, highlighting the 1, 2 and 3 level testing, and in the number of test tasks groups. Also, an adaptive algorithm for individual testing of student's educational achievements is considered, considering the essential characteristics of the computer process of checking knowledge and allowing it to be widely implemented in distance learning systems.

articleTitle: Application of Simulation Modeling to Determine the Parameters of Electrical Signals by Using a Quadrature Demodulator
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Currently, the complexity of electronic devices and the components that make up them is constantly growing. As a result the complexity of analyzing possible faults, the difficulty of identifying operational deficiencies and analyzing emerging errors is growing. In the educational process, these factors play a significant role and limit physical and mathematical modeling. One possible solution to this problem is the use of simulation modeling. One of the convenient tools for constructing circuit simulation models is the Simulink software package. This paper explores the application of Simulink in constructing a simulation model for a quadrature demodulator. This device is widely used in measurement technology and is used to perform amplitude, phase spectrum and frequency measurements. The features of the implementation of modifications of this method to improve the accuracy of measurement are considered. The results are obtained for the case of sinusoidal and polyharmonic signals, as well as signals distorted by noise, which allow us to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed techniques. The impact of the non-linearity of the analog-to-digital converter (ADC) on the measurement error of the parameters discussed above is investigated. Different types of nonlinearities are considered: pseudorandom, “worst case” representation, sinusoidal function, power polynomial function, Chebyshev polynomials of different orders. The issues of constructing the proposed model and its application in the educational process are considered.

articleTitle: A Hidden Method for Determining the Anxiety Level of a Training Contingent Through a Knowledge Test
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Studying and monitoring the level of anxiety of the contingent allows us to identify factors that contribute to anxiety and take measures to reduce or prevent it. It is an important aspect of a group's psychological and social well- being and can have an impact on their overall well-being, productivity and quality of life. The authors propose that anxiety can be detected implicitly through knowledge tests - based on the assumption that anxious people may show symptoms of their condition through performance on tasks that require cognitive abilities, such as knowledge tests. Although this method may be less obvious and direct, it offers the opportunity to measure anxiety without directly addressing the anxiety symptoms themselves. The development of a system for monitoring the anxiety of the contingent is a current area of research in modern society. Given the increasing complexity of social and psychological interactions in various communities, including educational institutions, work groups, and military and medical organizations, the need for adequate assessment and management of anxiety is becoming increasingly urgent. Monitoring the level of anxiety allows you to identify problematic situations and respond to them in a timely manner, providing the necessary psychological support and resources to overcome stress. The introduction of a system for monitoring the anxiety of the contingent in educational institutions helps improve the psychological health and well-being of the entire educational community. Providing tools for assessing and analyzing psychological well-being helps create conditions for effective learning and improve the overall quality of education.

articleTitle: Enhancing Interactive Information Support in Student Interdisciplinary Project Training: A Socio-Ecological Perspective of the Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Interactive information support tools play a pivotal role in project-based training, particularly when students engage in independent practical tasks outside the classroom over extended periods. This study investigates the socio-ecological conditions within the digital environment and explores the characteristics of interactive electronic tools that can enhance the effectiveness of independent work of students. The digital environment offers significant prospects for interactive educational content, educational communication, and information support. Socio-ecological aspects manifest through explicit and implicit interactions among actors within the educational process. These aspects can be effectively studied using hierarchical models within the learning ecology framework. Intelligent information support tools hold promises for enhancing teaching efficiency, especially when experts together lecturers engage in remote monitoring and asynchronous communication with students. Leveraging generative neural models for information support services further augments this potential. Additionally, integrating digital gamification methods based on mobile and immersive technologies complements intelligent learning tools. Experimental work with future teachers has revealed that socio-environmental factors significantly impact students' independent work and foster novel forms of communication within open digital environments. Ecological models of educational communication can serve as the foundation for socio-ecological education, facilitating personal adaptation to cultural and historical experiences.

articleTitle: Virtual Training Simulator and Medical Decision Support for Personalized Assessment of Severity and Prediction of the Patients' State (the Case of Acute Pancreatitis): Investigation of the Problem Area and Identification of the Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Multimorbid, polyetiological diseases (including acute pancreatitis) have a diverse and often unpredictable clinical picture intersecting with a number of other diseases. They are often characterized by a phased course and a high probability of developing severe complications and mortality. This changes and complicates the clinical picture and clinical course of the disease as well as the process of personalized assessment of severity and prediction of the condition of a complex object in medicine (the patients' body). As a result, education, training and advanced training in this area are also complicated. In order to improve the quality of medical intelligent and training systems, a new class of intelligent systems is proposed, namely cooperative self-adjusting hybrid intelligent systems ”Virtual councils for personalized assessment of severity and prognosis of patients' condition” (the case of acute pancreatitis). They are supposed to be developed within the framework of the problem-instrumental methodology of Professor A.V. Kolesnikov et al. This paper presents the results of the first stage of this methodology, namely: the results of an analysis of the specifities of the problematic environment for the diagnostic and prognostic assessing of the state of the patients' body using the example of acute pancreatitis; a functional model of the decision-making process regarding the problem of the personalized assessment of severity and predicting the condition of a patient with suspected acute pancreatitis as well as the results of its identification.

Author Keywords: assessment of the severity of the state

articleTitle: The Use of Intelligent Information Technologies in the Educational Process of Primary School
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article shows the specifics of the use of intelligent information technologies in primary school; their content, the possibilities of their use in teaching younger schoolchildren are determined; an algorithm for using a mind map, SWOT analysis, coaching is proposed; motivational, cognitive, operational, contact and creative criteria are determined, appropriate methods are proposed, three levels of the formation of the quality of knowledge and intellectual development of the individual are identified and characterized; the effectiveness of information technologies is proved.

articleTitle: Combating the Involnment of Children in Armed Conflicts: International Legal Demension
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article examines current problems of international law, covering provisions in the field of international protection of human rights, international humanitarian and international criminal law. The problem of combating the involvement of children in armed conflicts has been attracting attention of the entire international community for many years. Children are vulnerable members of society as they can be subject to a strong psychological influence from adults. In this regard, children are more likely to become objects of manipulation and are easier to attract to participate in armed conflicts than adults. The article also pays special attention to the implementation of responsibility after the end of an armed conflict in cases where children were participants in armed conflicts.

articleTitle: Engineering Technologies for the Design of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (Uavs) for Various Industries of the Agricultural Sector, Civil Engineering and Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are currently one of the most promising areas of scientific and technological progress. Having appeared less than a century ago as a branch of the aircraft industry, the industry for the development and improvement of UAVs has become so in demand that it has become isolated and has been designated as a priority area of technological progress, due to many parameters, such as: small dimensions of UAVs, which ensures their compactness, versatility due to extensive scope for their use. The stereotype about the use of unmanned aerial vehicles only as high-tech toys with the ability to take photos and videos has long been dispelled, since nowadays, due to the development of the industry, the list of operations performed with the help of UAVs is constantly increasing, and the advantages of unmanned aerial vehicles as aircraft equipment play a significant role here: the possibility use at any distance, including remotely, which facilitates many tasks performed by people. Numerous studies in this area in scientific laboratories in the higher education system affect many areas of this industry: from improving performance, by increasing the capacity of batteries or using alternative methods of powering devices (using gasoline or kerosene internal combustion engines, hydrogen fuel, or rechargeable lithium-polymer/lithium-ion batteries in as fuel cells), research into aerodynamic parameters, improved controllability and maneuverability, increased speed performance and load capacity, as well as resistance to adverse weather conditions (strong winds, showers, thunderstorms), which are directly influenced by design solutions and materials used in the creation, which determine the weight and the size of the future drone. Various solutions in the design and appearance of an unmanned vehicle bring innovation, since it is possible to create both unmanned airplanes and helicopters with decent payload capacity, as well as maneuverable but compact multicopters (tri-, quad-, hexa- and octocopters). Developments in the field of software for unmanned aerial vehicles are also constantly improving due to increasing requirements: for the quality of the resulting images for information analysis, their navigation, and improving their object recognition mechanisms, presented through the integration of machine vision tools. The development of UAVs intended for civil use is one of the promising areas of engineering science, since the number of industries that need automation and the use of UAVs to perform certain tasks is growing every year. Civil industries currently represent a huge range of areas, from geological exploration and oil well research to logistics, agro-industry, electric power and forestry. The article will clearly show the evolution of unmanned aerial vehicles, list their advantages and disadvantages, and also indicate the directions of their use in a variety of civil-oriented industries and the prospects for their development.

articleTitle: Teaching Arabic-Speaking and Chinese-Speaking Students to Physics with Using Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Using the example of pre-university and university preparation in physics for students from China and Arabic countries, methods for adapting educational material in physics using information technology are described. A simplified plan for presenting educational material for foreign students based on electronic learning tools in the electronic information educational environment of a medical university is proposed. The basic methodical procedures for a physics teacher providing distance learning in physics to foreign students from China and Arabic countries abroad have been determined.

articleTitle: The Introduction of Information Technologies Into Educational and Laboratory Complexes is an Important Step Towards the Digitalization of Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Digital transformation is one of the most important trends in the development of modern states, changing the appearance of virtually all spheres of the economy and the social sphere. The pandemic has hit many sectors of the economy, but has contributed to the accelerated development of the IT industry. It also showed the importance of introducing information and communication technologies and digital technologies into the work of state bodies, private enterprises, public organizations and educational institutions. One of the main tasks of the consistent socio-economic development of Uzbekistan is the widespread introduction of Information, communication and digital technologies into education. This is exactly the area that represents an effective tool capable of ensuring high-quality reform of economic sectors and spheres of public life. The article examines the trends in the introduction of information technologies in various sectors of the economy in Uzbekistan, the issues of virtualization of the educational and laboratory complex of educational institutions of the country. As an example, the interactive virtual stand “Minimization of Mile automata” in the discipline “Theory of information processes and systems” is considered.

articleTitle: Teaching and Learning STEM Subjects Using E-textbooks as Mediational Tools
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Teaching and learning STEM subjects using e-textbooks as mediational tools has become increasingly prominent in educational settings. E-textbooks offer several advantages over traditional textbooks, particularly in their ability to integrate multimedia elements such as videos, simulations, and interactive exercises. This multimedia capability enhances student engagement by catering to different learning styles and providing dynamic, real-world examples that can clarify complex concepts. Moreover, e-textbooks often allow for interactive features, such as embedded quizzes and assessments, which provide immediate feedback to students and enable teachers to monitor student progress more effectively. This real-time feedback mechanism supports personalized learning approaches, where students can revisit challenging topics or explore additional resources based on their individual needs. From a pedagogical standpoint, e-textbooks are designed to support active learning strategies by encouraging students to explore concepts through hands-on activities or collaborative projects facilitated by digital tools. This approach aligns with the principles of the Cultural Historical Activity Theory framework, promoting deeper understanding through active engagement with content. However, the effectiveness of e-textbooks in STEM education also depends on several factors, including access to technology, digital literacy skills of students and educators, and the quality of content and instructional design. Ensuring equitable access to digital resources and providing training and support for both teachers and students are crucial for maximizing the benefits of e-textbooks in STEM learning environments. In summary, while e-textbooks offer exciting opportunities to enhance teaching and learning in STEM subjects through multimedia integration, interactive features, and active learning strategies, their successful implementation requires careful consideration of technological infrastructure, pedagogical approaches, and support mechanisms within educational institutions.

articleTitle: Internet Technologies As Discursive Practices of Political Socialization of Student Youth
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the paper the essence of Internet-technologies as discursive practices of political socialization of youth in the educational space of the university is investigated. The article identifies main discursive practices of students: information Internet technology, technology of political mobilization, electoral or electoral technologies, PR-technologies and criteria of their influence on political socialization. An empirical analysis of socio-political activity of students was conducted. A wide potential of influence of universities on socio-political activity of students has been identified, which is confirmed by content analysis of social networks and university sites.

articleTitle: Problems of Using the Term STEM in Russian Education
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the definition of “STEM education” within the context of legislative, research, and methodological documents in the Russian educational and scientific environment. The authors of the article express a hypothesis about the appropriateness of using the term STEM as a generalization of interdisciplinary pedagogical practice implemented, among other things, through the project method, which allows for the rapid development of future specialists in the digital economy. The need for legislative clarification of the term STEM education was analyzed. Based on the analysis of pedagogical literature in the historical aspect, the relationship between the terms “polytechnic education” in Soviet pedagogy and “STEM education” during the period of digital transformation of the modern economy was revealed. An analogy was drawn in the goals of both didactics, aimed at bridging the gap between the fundamentalism of knowledge and a holistic scientific picture of the worldview. Analysis of federal state educational standards and exemplary general education programs allowed the authors to note the presence in them of some elements that are typical for STEM education (tasks, planned results, forms of educational activities). Thus, the conclusion was made that the didactic system in a modern school involves the inclusion of forms and practices of STEM education, without using the term STEM itself. Summarizing and systematizing the directions of educational activities of institutions of additional education created within the framework of the federal project “The Success of Every Child” of the national project “Education”, the authors noted the significant attention of the government to solving the problem of training engineering personnel in the digital economy, but also without using the term STEM. The article systematizes the experience of introducing elements of STEM didactics using the example of the system of general and additional education in the Khabarovsk Territory.

articleTitle: Grant Research of the Graduating Department as a Basis for Transdisciplinary Approach in Training Bachelors in the Direction of “Applied Mathematics and Informatics”
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article presents a description of a transdisci-plinary project-research task, carried out within the framework of laboratory works on several disciplines of the 5th and 6th semesters of the educational process in the direction of bachelor's degree 01.03.02 “Applied Mathematics and Informatics” in the form of a meta-game “Designing a management system for sustainable development of the territory of the northern part of the Volga-Akhtuba floodplain”, developed on the basis of the results obtained by the team of teachers and researchers of the Department of Fundamental Informatics and Optimal Learning of the Volgograd State University implementing the RSF grant № 23-621-0017. The project-research task is aimed at the students' mastering the connection of substantive analysis of decision-making problems in the ecological-economic system with econometric, ecological-metric, expert, geoinformational, game-theoretic methods of research, methods of graph theory, integer optimization and computational experiment, methods and technologies of simulation hydrodynamic and geoinformational modeling and distributed computing. The relevance of the research topic proposed to the students is determined by the fact that nowadays all over the world the territories of floodplains of regulated rivers (FT) are subject to progressive ecological and socio-economic degradation due to the violation of the natural hydrological regime, depression of the river channel, high anthropogenic load. The assignment includes optimization of the hydraulic en-gineering project for installation of a system of flood dams by the Federal Center on the territory of the Volga-Akhtuba floodplain, taking into account the activity of its economic entities. To perform the work it is proposed to use the models and algorithms developed under the RSF grant: a program for calculating flood water dynamics, a geoinformational digital elevation model of the floodplain area, a heuristic algorithm for project optimization that can be adjusted to the specific data of the assignment, and models of two meta-games. The difference in the values of environmental and economic effects for different project variants allows us to study the problem of synthesizing an optimal mechanism for its co-financing by economic entities of the territory. Calculation of the target function of the Center is carried out by a given algorithm using digital maps of flood inundation built in the course of numerical simulation, increasing the total project resource. In order to study the problem of maximizing the project resource, the assignment provides for the study of a meta-game (the “Center-Agents” model) that allows different variants of the parties' awareness within the framework of two mathematical models of hierarchical games H2 (HO) and H1(H0). For numerical search of equilibria in the game of H0 agents we propose an algorithm developed within the framework of the RSF grant, which uses the method of “threat-counter- threats”. The second meta-game (the model “Federal Center-Municipal Center-Agents”) simulates the problem of managing the socio-economic development of the floodplain area. The assignment proposes to compare the effectiveness of the punishment and reward mechanisms used by the Federal Center to manage the process.

articleTitle: Methodology and Technology of Using Neural Networks in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The use of modern computer technologies in both industrial and service sectors is an evolutionary development associated with reducing infrastructure costs for all industrial enterprises and improving working conditions. In this regard, training in the field of information technology is becoming increasingly popular. The organization of innovative learning spaces, research into the methodology and technology of using neural networks in agriculture is relevant and in demand. The training of highly qualified personnel is aimed at mastering a group of competencies related to automation in the agricultural sector. Thus, computer vision has begun to be frequently used in the agricultural sector, as it helps with the automation of monitoring crops and animals. It can perform many functions in semi- or automatic mode, such as: monitoring and recognizing crops, identifying plant pathologies, studying animal patterns and making predictions based on the data obtained. Important competencies are related to the ability to use unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in areas related to agricultural production, livestock farming, which involves keeping large and small livestock, crop production, aerial photography of arable land, and optimization of the consumption of resources necessary to maintain the stable operation of the agro-industrial complex (herbicides, pesticides, fertilizers and chemicals), which are also covered in the study.

articleTitle: Generative AI Models with Their Full Reveal*
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper deals with Large Language Models (LLM). We present a historical overview of the development of text generation algorithms. The aim of the paper is to show the main properties and limitations of services based on Large Language Models when their results are used in scientific and educational texts. We touch on concepts such as sampling from distribution, Recurrent Neural Network, Attention mechanism, Transformer architecture and provide guidelines for the ethical use of generated texts in scientific and academic papers. We have presented the material in a popular form, so that it is possible to understand the principles of generative services with general erudition and certain computer skills. At the same time, the key concepts are provided with references that will allow readers to delve into the area on their own if necessary.

articleTitle: Effective Practice of Learning English at Universities in Uzbekistan. Features of the Linguocognitive Approach to Grammatical Phenomena of Language
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Teaching foreign languages is one of the priorities of education reform in Uzbekistan. At the state level, a number of targets and goals have been set to achieve new standards in the study of foreign languages in order to achieve drastic improvements in their development by students. In the republic, much attention is paid to the development of the English language teaching system using a holistic approach. Nowadays, knowledge of foreign languages is the key to success in almost all spheres of life. Now in Uzbekistan, the demand and interest in their study, especially English, has increased so much that people of all ages are trying to master it. The main reason for this is the rapid integration of Uzbekistan into all international processes, an ever-growing number of native English speakers and a rich database of scientific, educational, popular and other publications in this language. The increasing demand for language learning places a great responsibility on teachers. The article presents the methodology of teaching English at the Tashkent State Pedagogical University. The ways of representing grammatical causality in the structure of the English language are analyzed based on selected examples from literary texts. The analysis of English texts demonstrates the cognitive aspect of this grammatical phenomenon. Since grammar and language are inseparable and essential parts of cognition, the grammatical category of causality is explored in isolation from the principles of cognition and cognitive learning

articleTitle: Balancing Innovation with Ethics: AI Applications for Enhancing Language Competence in Academic Writing and Reading
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In an era characterized by rapid technological advancements, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into education has emerged as a transformative force, particularly in the realm of language skills development. AI-driven tools offer unprecedented opportunities to enhance academic writing and reading proficiency among students. However, as educators harness these innovative technologies, a critical imperative arises: ensuring the ethical use of AI in educational contexts. This article explores the delicate balance between innovation and ethics in leveraging AI applications to elevate language competence in academic settings. Specifically, we delve into the ethical considerations surrounding the adoption of AI tools for enhancing writing and reading skills. By examining ethical dilemmas, best practices, and implications, we seek to illuminate the path towards responsible AI integration in language education.
